name: 🥒 Cottage Cheese & Cucumbers
tagline: Cool, crunchy and salty: cottage cheese with cucumbers and tomatoes, like a mini Greek salad.

items.name: Salt, pepper, and everything seasoning or dill

steps.text: Slice the cucumbers into thick coins and halve the tomatoes.
Spoon cottage cheese into 4 small bowls.
Pile the cucumbers and tomatoes on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt, pepper and everything seasoning.

kid_jobs.job: Slice the cucumbers (butter knife works on minis)

chef_tip: A tiny drizzle of good olive oil and flaky salt turns plain cottage cheese into something that tastes like a restaurant snack.
make_ahead: Slice cucumbers ahead and keep in a container with a damp paper towel.
swaps: Use cucumber slices as 'chips' to scoop
